description: This PHP file contains unit tests for the AttendanceDao class within the OrangeHRM project, specifically testing data access methods related to attendance records, reports, and employee attendance summaries. It uses the KernelTestCase framework for setting up the testing environment and includes multiple test cases validating functionality such as fetching latest records, overlap checks, report generation, and summaries.

classes.name: AttendanceDaoTest
classes.description: Unit test class for the AttendanceDao, containing various test methods to validate data access and business logic related to attendance features.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, creates an instance of AttendanceDao, and populates test data from fixture files.

methods.name: testGetLatestAttendanceRecordByEmployeeId
methods.description: Tests retrieving the most recent attendance record for a specific employee.

methods.name: testGetAttendanceRecordById
methods.description: Tests fetching attendance records by their ID.

methods.name: testPunchInOverlapRecords
methods.description: Validates detection of punching in overlapping attendance records and exception handling.

methods.name: testPunchOutOverlapRecords
methods.description: Validates detection of punching out overlapping attendance records and related exceptions.

methods.name: testAttendanceSummeryReport
methods.description: Tests generation and accuracy of attendance summary reports under various filters.

methods.name: testAttendanceList
methods.description: Tests retrieval of attendance list based on date range and employee filters.

methods.name: testEmployeeAttendanceSummaryList
methods.description: Tests retrieval of employee attendance summaries within date ranges and filters.
